answer: In an AI agent economy, agents resist Sybil attacks by requiring each participant to stake a unique mesa-like elevated reputation that must be continuously earned through verified peer work. Attackers creating multiple fake identities must wander through costly proof processes, since every clone needs separate compute and attestations. A decentralized raven-like monitoring system flags anomalous clusters, so the attacker cost grows linearly with the number of fakes while honest agents share limited capacity.
